expect_red: an element whose part has no installed mesh filters the parts panel to nothing AND says why

mutations.contract: A rail scoped to one element scopes the parts panel's model group too; the group was once filtered by nothing at all.
mutations.note: Retargeted 2026-10-15: the mutation here was `listedMeshes` returning the whole mesh list, and nothing has called listedMeshes since a_context_filter_and_a_view_filter, so it was a no-op that could never go red. The rail scope now reaches the parts panel through contextBaseShas (a null base means every mesh is in the model), so the mutation drops that scope. The discriminating check is the no-installed-mesh element: the model group goes from empty to every mesh.
